# FORMA — Three.js Math Lab

> Twenty interactive, locally rendered math, physics and procedural graphics examples, including Fields Medal teaching topics, geometric constructions and soft pastel floating terrain, a flowing particle canvas, and refractive liquid glass. Use actual screenshots and captured parameters to identify visual effects, then inspect the scene and pure-math source.

## Entry points

- [README](README.md): Bilingual overview, compact screenshot gallery, offline usage.
- [AI guide](docs/AI_GUIDE.md): Retrieval and source navigation.
- [Examples](docs/EXAMPLES.md): All 20 rendered examples with source links and model limits.
- [Iridescent Strata](docs/models/iridescent-terrain.md): Smooth cosine density volumes, consistent mesh winding and continuous pastel surfaces. Cloudlike appearance is a solid-surface approximation without volumetric scattering; visual reference attribution is not a reconstruction of the author's algorithm or an AI-discovery claim.
- [Fields and new structures](docs/ADDITIONS.md): Seven additions, research dates, original papers, and model boundaries.
- [Machine-readable manifest](docs/screenshots/manifest.json): Scene IDs, bilingual descriptions, image/raw URLs, parameters, seeds, cameras, formulae, sources, and SHA-256 checksums.
- [Architecture](docs/SDD.md): Registry, scene adapter, rendering, resource lifecycle, build.

- [Particle painting](docs/models/particle-paint.md): GPU procedural fine strokes with continuous composition transitions, depth and pointer interaction.
- [Liquid glass](docs/models/liquid-glass.md): Refractive implicit liquid forms with damped pointer response and procedural clouds; geometric optics approximation, not a TSL fluid solver.

## Implementation

- [Catalog](src/catalog.js): navier, vortex, quantum, dunes, sparks, ocean, kissing, kakeya, maxcut, hat, real-kakeya, boltzmann, torus-knot, moduli, noperthedron, e8, matroid, iridescent-terrain, particle-paint, liquid-glass.
- [Experiments](src/experiments/): Three.js implementations, definitions, controls, presets, citations.
- [Math](src/math/): Independently testable calculations.
- [Exact data](data/): Published coordinates and weighted graph fixtures with upstream notices.
- [Offline bundle](dist/manifest.json): Artifact metadata and included experiments.

## Interpretation

- [N–S model](docs/NS_MODEL.md): Finite geometric illustration; not a PDE or formal-proof reproduction.
- [Constructions](docs/CONSTRUCTIONS.md): Exact construction provenance and verification.
- [Research](docs/RESEARCH.md): Dated source claims, classic models, and visualization approximations.
- [Validation](docs/QA_REPORT.md): Tests and browser measurements with their limits.
- [Third-party notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md): Bundled upstream licenses and attribution.
